name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Between Anders and Bauer, one goes with Pilot and the other with 18 ly.
Between Forge and Lumen, one goes with Fontaine and the other with Captain.
Exactly one of these is true: Pilot goes with Forge; Aurora goes with 16 ly; Aurora goes with 18 ly.
22 ly goes with at least two of Okafor, Medic, and Cortex.
Either Fontaine goes with Forge or Aurora goes with Bauer.
Either Captain goes with Bauer or 20 ly goes with Aurora.
Forge goes with Technician if and only if Cortex goes with 18 ly.
